propositions: Extract identity transition call graph from BindingStore into BindingLifecycle while preserving all existing behaviors exactly, including targeted stale reverse removal, pending/confirmed semantics, immutable numeric-ID re-key, and legacy no-ID behavior.

Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity entry, verified by reloading both indexes from disk and asserting one-to-one correspondence.
bind_confirm remains last-writer-wins with exactly one targeted pop of the differing old reverse key only, with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Numeric-ID re-key operation moves issues by swapping both indexes instead of retiring, decoupling from absence/tombstone policy that belongs to S2 T2.

note_absent_or_rekey facade method coordinates by attempting lifecycle re-key and falls through to note_absent only when re-key declines due to missing entry or unchanged key, preserving exact caller visibility.
